limit.description: Number of markets to return (1–20, default 10).

query.description: Optional keyword filter applied to market titles (case-insensitive). E.g. 'btc', 'eth', 'sol'.

slug.description: If provided, fetch a specific market by its Limitless slug (e.g. 'btc-up-or-down-5-min-1780703750051'). Overrides other filters.

trade_type.description: Filter by trade mechanism: 'clob' (order book) or 'amm' (automated market maker). Default returns all.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns active prediction markets from Limitless Exchange with current Yes/No probabilities. Covers short-duration crypto markets (5-min, 15-min BTC/ETH direction), plus longer-term markets. Returns title, implied yes/no prices, expiration, volume, categories, and slug. $0.034/call — free upstream, no API key.
